'''Vodd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point she became part of the [[Order of Revan]] and defected the Empire, joining with the Revanite forces on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. During the [[Battle of Rishi]] in [[3637 BBY]] she and a fellow Revanite [[Obai]] tried to stop a strike team from reaching the signal jammer on the [[Razorback Island]], but failed and were killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Vodd appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
